Summary: Verify Guest Mode Exploration without Login
Description: Validate that unauthenticated guests can launch the app, skip login, view the restaurant feed, and explore dish menus.
Preconditions: App installed on Android device or emulator; user is logged out.
Test Step:
1. Launch the app.
2. Tap 'Explore as Guest' on the landing screen.
3. Verify landing on Discovery Screen.
4. Browse restaurant cards and dishes.
Expected Result: User enters Discovery feed immediately without authentication prompt. All restaurant cards and dishes load from local SQLite/Firestore catalog.

Summary: Verify Phone OTP Login with Firebase Auth
Description: Validate end-to-end OTP authentication with 6-digit verification code.
Preconditions: Network connectivity active; Firebase Auth enabled.
Test Step:
1. Launch app and enter phone number.
2. Tap 'Send OTP'.
3. Enter valid 6-digit OTP.
4. Tap 'Verify & Continue'.
Expected Result: OTP is dispatched. Upon verification, authenticated user profile is established in Firestore users/{userId} and session token persisted locally.

Summary: Verify Invalid OTP Handling and Error Feedback
Description: Verify that submitting an incorrect or expired OTP shows error message and prevents access.
Expected Result: Inline error message 'Invalid OTP' appears with vibration/alert. User remains on OTP screen.

Description: Verify dynamic search and category chips filter the catalog in real-time.
Preconditions: Catalog seeded with restaurants and dishes.
Test Step: 1. Type cuisine name 'Biryani' or 'Burger' in search bar.\n2. Tap 'Pure Veg' filter chip.\n3. Tap 'Rating 4.0+' filter chip.
Expected Result: Catalog updates instantaneously (<50ms). Only dishes/restaurants matching query and active filters are visible.

Summary: Verify Add to Cart with Customizable Add-ons
Description: Validate adding dishes to cart with item customizer (spice level, extra cheese, portion size).
Test Step:
1. Click '+' on a dish with customizable add-ons.
2. Select spice level 'Medium'.
3. Check add-on 'Extra Cheese (+₹40)'.
4. Tap 'Add to Cart'.
Test Data: Dish: Royal Biryani, Addon: Extra Cheese
Expected Result: Cart badge counter increments to 1. Cart subtotal updates with dish base price + add-on price accurately.

Summary: Verify Server Authoritative Price Calculation & Anti-Tampering
Description: Ensure client cannot tamper with order total by intercepting checkout payload.
Test Step: 1. Client attempts to submit order with modified expectedTotal = ₹1 (100 paise).\n2. Backend validates against authoritative database prices.
Test Data: Client Total: 100 paise, Real Total: 43400 paise
Expected Result: Order submission is intercepted. Tampering detected. Backend returns 422/400 and rejects fraudulent transaction.

Summary: Verify Seamless Checkout via Razorpay SDK & UPI
Description: Verify user can select payment method (Razorpay, UPI, Cash) and place valid order.
Preconditions: User logged in with saved delivery address and non-empty cart.
Test Step:
1. Open Cart screen.
2. Select 'Google Pay (UPI)'.
3. Tap 'Place Order'.
4. Confirm transaction.
Expected Result: Order is confirmed, assigned unique order ID (e.g. #5832), saved to Firestore 'orders', and cart is cleared.

Summary: Verify Order Idempotency on Network Retry / Double Tap
Description: Ensure duplicate payment or double-tapping 'Place Order' never creates duplicate charges or orders.
Test Step: 1. Rapidly tap 'Place Order' twice in <100ms.\n2. Simulate network retry with identical idempotency key.
Expected Result: Backend/Local engine detects duplicate key. Returns cached first order without creating second billing or record.

Summary: Verify Live Rider GPS Tracking on Leaflet OpenStreetMap
Description: Verify order tracking screen shows active delivery rider coordinate stream and route polyline.
Preconditions: Order placed and status changed to 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY'.
Test Step: 1. Navigate to Order Tracking screen.\n2. Observe live map view.\n3. Verify delivery rider pin movement and ETA update.
Expected Result: OpenStreetMap Leaflet view renders without API key errors. Pulsing rider marker animates along route to customer address.

Summary: Verify Google Maps JS Integration with Maps API Key
Description: Verify Google Maps WebView loads map tiles and restaurant markers with user's Google Maps API key.
Preconditions: Google Maps API Key configured in local.properties and build.gradle.kts.
Test Step: 1. Open Restaurant Detail or Order Tracking map.\n2. Toggle engine to 'Google Maps'.\n3. Verify tile loading and marker rendering.
Expected Result: Google Maps loads smoothly with custom restaurant pins, pan/zoom gestures, and zero crashes.

Summary: Verify Native Turn-by-Turn Navigation Intent Launch
Description: Verify clicking 'Open in Google Maps' launches native Google Maps app with destination coordinates.
Preconditions: Device with Google Maps app installed.
Test Step: 1. Tap on a restaurant card on Discovery map.\n2. Click 'Get Directions' / 'Open in Google Maps'.
Expected Result: Android geo: intent fires. Native Google Maps opens instantly with turn-by-turn navigation route pre-populated.

Description: Verify reserving a dine-in table with party size, date, time slot, and special requests.
Test Step:
1. Tap 'Book a Table' on restaurant page.
2. Select Date: Tomorrow, Time: 7:30 PM, Guests: 4.
3. Add note: 'Window seat'.
4. Tap 'Confirm Reservation'.
Expected Result: Booking saved to Firestore 'table_bookings/{bookingId}'. Status 'CONFIRMED' displayed in user's Bookings tab.

Summary: Verify QR Code Table Dine-In Tab Settlement
Description: Verify customer seated at restaurant can scan table QR code, view live dining tab, and settle bill.
Preconditions: Active dining tab on Table T1.
Test Step:
1. Scan Table QR code (e.g. Table T1).
2. Review items ordered at table.
3. Apply ₹50 server tip.
4. Settle payment via UPI.
Expected Result: Dining tab is marked 'SETTLED' with authoritative invoice TXN-DIN. Duplicate payment attempts on same tab blocked (409).

Description: Verify splitting table bill equally among multiple diners.
Test Step: 1. On Table Tab settlement screen, tap 'Split Bill'.\n2. Enter party size: 4 diners.\n3. Verify calculated per-person share.
Expected Result: App accurately calculates ₹286 per person. Settle single share or complete bill with zero rounding discrepancy.

Description: Verify that an order status or booking updated on cloud is reflected on the device in real-time.
Preconditions: App connected to Firebase project restro-42877.
Test Step: 1. Update order status from 'PREPARING' to 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' in Firestore console.\n2. Observe mobile app UI without refreshing.
Expected Result: Real-time snapshot listener receives event in <500ms. Order tracking progress bar advances immediately.

Summary: Verify Offline Resilience with Local SQLite DB
Description: Verify app continues functioning in airplane mode and synchronizes when connection is restored.
Test Step:
1. Toggle Airplane Mode ON.
2. Launch app and browse cached catalog.
3. View previous order history.
4. Toggle Airplane Mode OFF.
Expected Result: App loads immediately from SQLite database without white screen or crash. When online, pending data syncs to cloud.

Description: Verify submitting 5-star rating with review text writes to Firestore and updates average rating.
Preconditions: User has a completed delivery or dine-in experience.
Test Step:
1. Tap 'Leave Review' on completed order.
2. Select 5 stars.
3. Enter text: 'Delicious food and prompt delivery!'.
4. Tap 'Submit Review'.
Expected Result: Review is stored in 'reviews/{reviewId}'. Restaurant rating recalculates and displays updated average.
